parties.respondent: Laxmi Narayan Das (Dead) thr. LRs & ors.

summary: Stale land claim; record of rights finalized 1962 not challenged for decades; civil suit dismissed as withdrawn without liberty to refile; writ petition filed ignoring prior dismissal; HC improperly granted relief without addressing laches; settlement officer's 1990 observation on GAD representation not judicial determination; forum shopping via civil suit, writ petition; relief cannot override unrevised record of rights; appeal allowed to reverse HC order.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; original settlement order upheld; no direction for alternative land allotment.
